title: Binary encoding of bit strings
statement: For every finite bit string $s$, form a natural number by folding its bits from right to left using the binary operation $b,n\mapsto 2n+b$, starting from $1$. The binary expansion of this number, written with the most significant bit first, is the bit $1$ followed by $s$.
